GRADE 6 KISWAHILI — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: KISWAHILI
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo darasani na rafiki yako, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo completely.
   C. Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo.

2. About Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo nyumbani na wazazi, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo completely.
   C. Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo.

3. About Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo sokoni katika kaunti yako, which statement is correct?
   A. Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo completely.
   C. Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo.

5. About Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana darasani na rafiki yako, which statement is correct?
   A. kutambua hatua za kiusalama katika matumiziya vifaa vya kidijitali anaposoma,
   B. Learners should ignore Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana completely.
   C. Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana.

6. About Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana nyumbani na wazazi, which statement is correct?
   A. kusakura matini kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma vyenye mada lengwa,
   B. Learners should ignore Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana completely.
   C. Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana.

7. About Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana sokoni katika kaunti yako, which statement is correct?
   A. kutumia vifaa ya kidijitali kwa urahisi ili kupata matini yanayolengwa,
   B. Learners should ignore Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana completely.
   C. Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusoma 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana.

9. About Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua Rasmi darasani na rafiki yako, which statement is correct?
   A. kutambua barua rasmi kwa kuzingatia muundo wake,
   B. Learners should ignore Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua Rasmi completely.
   C. Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua Rasmi is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua Rasmi.

10. About Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua Rasmi nyumbani na wazazi, which statement is correct?
   A. kutambua vipengele vya barua rasmi ili kuvizingatia katika uandishi,
   B. Learners should ignore Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua Rasmi completely.
   C. Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua Rasmi is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua Rasmi.

11. About Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua Rasmi sokoni katika kaunti yako, which statement is correct?
   A. kuandika barua rasmi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo,
   B. Learners should ignore Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua Rasmi completely.
   C. Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua Rasmi is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua Rasmi.

13. About Sarufi 4.4.1 Ngeli ya YA-YA darasani na rafiki yako, which statement is correct?
   A. kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya YA – YA katika sentensi,
   B. Learners should ignore Sarufi 4.4.1 Ngeli ya YA-YA completely.
   C. Sarufi 4.4.1 Ngeli ya YA-YA is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Sarufi 4.4.1 Ngeli ya YA-YA.

14. About Sarufi 4.4.1 Ngeli ya YA-YA nyumbani na wazazi, which statement is correct?
   A. kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya YA-YA kutokana na upatanisho wa kisarufi,
   B. Learners should ignore Sarufi 4.4.1 Ngeli ya YA-YA completely.
   C. Sarufi 4.4.1 Ngeli ya YA-YA is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Sarufi 4.4.1 Ngeli ya YA-YA.

15. About Sarufi 4.4.1 Ngeli ya YA-YA sokoni katika kaunti yako, which statement is correct?
   A. kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA –YA katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi,
   B. Learners should ignore Sarufi 4.4.1 Ngeli ya YA-YA completely.
   C. Sarufi 4.4.1 Ngeli ya YA-YA is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Sarufi 4.4.1 Ngeli ya YA-YA.

17. About Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali darasani na rafiki yako, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali completely.
   C. Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali.

18. About Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali nyumbani na wazazi, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali completely.
   C. Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali.

   A. Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali completely.
   C. Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza 5.1.1 Methali.

21. About Methali darasani na rafiki yako, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Methali using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Methali completely.
   C. Methali is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Methali.

22. About Methali nyumbani na wazazi, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Methali at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Methali completely.
   C. Methali is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Methali.

23. About Methali sokoni katika kaunti yako, which statement is correct?
   A. Methali helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Methali completely.
   C. Methali is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Methali.

25. About Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu darasani na rafiki yako, which statement is correct?
   A. kujadili dhana za ukwapi na utao katika shairi ili kuzibainisha,
   B. Learners should ignore Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu completely.
   C. Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.

26. About Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu nyumbani na wazazi, which statement is correct?
   A. kutambua mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia kwa kuzingatia muundo,
   B. Learners should ignore Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu completely.
   C. Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.

27. About Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu sokoni katika kaunti yako, which statement is correct?
   A. kusoma mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia ili kupata ujumbe,

   C. Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.

29. About Kuandika 5.3.1 Insha za Maelezo darasani na rafiki yako, which statement is correct?
   A. kutambua insha za maelezo katika matini mbalimbali,
   B. Learners should ignore Kuandika 5.3.1 Insha za Maelezo completely.
   C. Kuandika 5.3.1 Insha za Maelezo is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kuandika 5.3.1 Insha za Maelezo.

   D. There is no need to practise Kuandika 5.3.1 Insha za Maelezo.
